messages:
Priya (CS): Heads-up: Meridian Health sent back the vendor security form. They're asking for a concise dataflow diagram, SOC2 scope confirmation, and evidence of KMS usage before the renewal review next Tue.
Jorge (Onboarding): Understood. Do they need the full infra diagram or just PII paths?
Priya (CS): They specifically asked: 'where patient data travels, encryption at rest/in transit, retention, and how deletion requests are handled' — so PII/customer-data paths plus retention/deletion.
Elliot (SRE): I can produce a minimal flow showing ingress -> s3 (encrypted) -> GPU pool (ephemeral) -> metrics. Quick Q: Which KMS do they want called out?
Priya (CS): They called out AWS KMS and an expectation of region residency (EU). They use our hosted product in eu-west-1.
Rachael (Legal): Note: highlight that embeddings retention default is 90 days for EU customers, with on-request purge. Also include statement that SOC2 coverage includes Logging, Incident Response, and Change Management. I'll need the exported artifact before I sign off.
Jorge (Onboarding): I'll adapt the last dataflow we used for Greenlock. Will annotate retention and manual deletion SLA.
DevInfraBot: Reminder: Latest subprocessor CSV exists at drive:/shared/subprocessors/2025-02-subprocessors.csv
Elliot (SRE): Posting quick text diagram for review:
```
client -> api.redwood.com (HTTPS)
-> ingress LB (eu-west-1)
-> s3-eu (encrypted, KMS=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:key/xyz)
-> redwood-hosted-gpu-pool (ephemeral nodes, KV cache not persisted)
-> audit logs -> logstore (retention: 30d) / SOC2 logging in-scope
Retention: embeddings=90d (EU), logs=30d
Deletion: automated cron job + manual support-initiated deletion (support SLA 48h)
```
Priya (CS): Nice. Jorge, can you add a one-line about Dedicated availability as an opt-in and point them to the enterprise eval page? They asked about alternatives in the thread.
Jorge (Onboarding): Adding: "Dedicated (customer-dedicated pools) available via contract; contact your AE for region/SLAs."
Rachael (Legal): Also include: "KMS keys may be customer-managed in Dedicated or Private deployments; hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS unless otherwise contracted."
Priya (CS): Perfect. I'll craft a short cover note and attach the PNG + subprocessor CSV. If we get legal sign-off by EOD tomorrow we can share before the renewal meeting.
Elliot (SRE): Exported diagram attached: `meridian-dataflow-0900.png`. I also exported a minimal subprocessor list: `meridian-subprocessors-0900.csv`. Uploaded to drive and attached in thread.
Priya (CS): Sent to customer with cover: "See attached: dataflow, retention, deletion SLA, KMS note. Happy to do 10-min sync ahead of renewal."
DevInfraBot: Policy check: DPA template includes region_residency = eu-west-1, kms_field_populated = true
Rachael (Legal): Reviewed and OK to send. Minor edit: replace 'embeddings' with 'model outputs/embeddings' for clarity.
Priya (CS): Done. Customer replied: "Thanks — this answers our questions. We'd like a 10-min call on Mon to confirm."
Jorge (Onboarding): Scheduled 10-min sync Mon 09:15 CET, added to calendar.
Priya (CS): Closing thread: legal signed off, assets sent, call scheduled. Will update renewal doc after call. :white_check_mark:
